verdict.rationale: Letta documents organization-level roles/collaborators with private-by-default agents and 'sharing controls' plus team-based permission setting for agents (letta-docs-97, letta-docs-98, letta-docs-87), and tool-call permission policies like canUseTool and unrestricted/acceptEdits/standard modes (letta-docs-44, letta-docs-85). However, these are coarse org/tool-level controls, not memory-specific ACLs or policies governing who can read/write specific memory blocks, and there's no documented audit log or access trail for memory access (the /doctor command audits memory bloat/placement, not access). Missing for 10: memory-specific read/write ACLs, granular role definitions beyond default org sharing, and an access audit log/trail.
